## Fixed aab3 fourth CI — R1 scope closed, execution still pending (2026-11-17)

The exact R1 67b42d150f59a9c74dae7287776beb3ac1bd8d00 has four complete, self-read reviews: root 32, guard 48, semantic 40 and binding 44 (164 static checks). The preceding published source actual gate ca1b9cc4a3666168a8f13ca0fd52aa4fab2abe47 is closed with 25 root and 33 independent checks. Its 810 complete pointer identities include 28 explicitly retained inherited repository-scope corrections; no unresolved pointer is silently promoted.

The selected execution source is fixed aab3d84ceb40674abb2139c6cc82a383c0b14df4, compared with the real previously tested ancestor 86f52244b5375834a4040cbc63803d68cc708087. The complete seven-commit interval contains 143 paths: 140 documentation changes and three preserving source repairs (diagnostic boundary search, two expected collaboration model values, and strict missing-settlement readiness in the Windows fixture). No artificial base or trigger edit is used. All 42 workflow bodies were joined; 41 are unchanged and the remaining one changes only its two expected-model strings.

The exact proposed same-repository opened Draft selects eight workflow families: CodeQL and Sentry preserve explicit Draft skips; six executable families comprise 48 prospective jobs, including 18 Host Desktop lanes, four frontend shards, five Host Process platforms, five packaged platforms, nine Stage1 jobs, announcements and CI feedback. The three other previously Draft-skipped families are unmatched by this source interval. Checkout accounting is 42 explicit-head jobs, five default-event jobs and one aggregate without checkout; the two separate main runtime.lock inputs must be captured independently. Prospective selection is not observed execution. The existing Draft Full qualification policy failure remains expected and cannot be bypassed.

Later original CI3 observation20, at 2026-11-17 17:12:49 UTC, records all eleven runs terminal; none may be polled again. Three workflow conclusions are cancelled. Their cancellation cause is unknown; three aggregate/embedded job-log requests returned no content and are retained once as unavailable. Existing failed/unreached artifact deliveries and all prior runtime attempts remain spent. This later evidence does not rewrite R1's earlier historical snapshot. Late complete captures, chunk manifests/chunks, outcome analyses and PNG reviews require their separate durable checkpoint.

This publication changes documentation only: all 53 other root entries, 8,799 non-document leaves, 5,020 production files, cap 800, 141 exceptions, 42 workflows and all 115 parent catalog values/27 bundles/totals remain unchanged. The two complete Markdown prefixes are preserved. No new branch, PR, run, source execution or green result is claimed here. The existing next steps are full root and independent actual publication readbacks, immutable external admission, then one-shot exact proposed ref creation and Draft opening. No executable R2 or additional gate is introduced. No real Claude/Codex (including version probes), Ready, main merge, release/default activation, Stage2 or broad native/vendor qualification is authorized.
